summary: Narrow Shirley Street kerb near the dead-end bend, homes close on all sides.
reasons: Sloping uphill away from the bend

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11 m (at 21 m) and 23-24 m; apartments and houses all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed narrow lane; grass strip and a car at the bend give some room to pull off.
drivers.convention: Cars park here; 2P weekday 9-5 and some no-stopping signs along the kerb.

flags: Steep: about 3.4% over the whole stretch, 5.6% max
Beyond 20 m the lane narrows between trees and fences
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over most of the kerb; open sky near the start from the east.

best_section.where: South kerb at the Shirley Street dead-end bend, beside grass strip
